headline: CFO designee will become a voting member, replacing Kris Silva; prior minutes approved; school repair work discussed.
summary: The subcommittee discussed ongoing repair and construction work at Baldwin, Jenks, Fallon, Goff, and Varieur schools. It approved the minutes of the prior meeting. Matthew Wildenhain said the CFO's designee will become a voting member, replacing Kris Silva, who is leaving the district.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the August 17, 2026 meeting, with all members voting yes.
Stated that the CFO's designee will be added as a voting member, replacing Kris Silva.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to approve: Mark Second: Hersh Yea: All Motion carries.
the designee of the CFO will be added as a voting member of the Facilities Subcommittee as a replacement to Kris Silva, who is leaving the district.
